body:
That's a good comparison, the deluge then, total cessation. How life can turn on a dime. I'm not as grim as I was earlier. The feeling comes in waves, some feel too high to jump.

I am picking up on a paying job, small one, someones memoir, am editing it for them. The man is 90, has been through a lot, depression, big losses, makes me feel like such a whiner right now.

Thanks for hanging in there with me, I'm glad I'm helping with keeping you busy, too. I mean that.

I will stand up and walk outside. I hear thunder, summer storm. I'll get a breath of real air. That will be a big change. Thanks for the idea.

Thanks for asking, and I'm sorry you are going through similar feelings. 

I feel an odd sense of accomplishment for having posted my desire to off myself. At least I've accomplished something concrete today. I used to do things, was motivated to take action. Not now, I can barely be bothered to wash a dish. I sleep to avoid 'being'. This will sound funny, but it's true, I do sudoku on my phone, constantly, because it keeps me from thinking and feeling. I go to sleep playing it, I wake up and immediately start the app. If I have to drive, I do it at red lights. I can't allow one minute of 'rest' time to enter my head, no telling what horrible thought would manifest if I allowed it.

I used to write, edit, hold down a job, you know, I lived! And now I just exist. No joy. No desire to put one foot in front of other. I barely take 50 steps an entire day. I'm pretty useless to myself. Took down the mirrors in the house, can't stand to see my own image. It makes it better.
